title: [MTR4] Gamiel's Basic Gray Trains
description: This project adds basic gray versions of existing MTR Trains , making them easy to retexture.
body:
These are retextures of existing trains (e.g Class 802, etc) in an basic gray tone, to be easier to retexture.

Current Trains in This Pack: 
- Class 802

Please note that 
1. I do not require ANYTHING out of the people who use this pack, you may use this pack however you please
2. Requests for new trains can be made through the repo's issue tab
